hero.scroll: Normal document flow; no hero parallax, crop change or scroll-scrubbed lettering. Header becomes a solid 64 px surface only after the hero exits. Preserve its footprint.
hero.hover: Underline actionable text over 180 ms. Photo and brand wordmark stay still.
hero.activate: Use real navigation links. Menu is a button with aria-expanded; Escape closes and focus returns.
hero.touch: Same visible actions; menu button at 44 × 44 px minimum. Approved desktop composition gets a separately art-directed mobile crop later.
hero.react: Hero + SiteHeader; IntersectionObserver sentinel owns header mode. Hero content has no React animation state.

product.scroll: Enter as one composition at 15% visibility: translateY 12→0 px over 600 ms, once. Do not animate each label separately.
product.hover: Only on fine pointers, crossfade primary to on-body/texture image over 240 ms. Name, price and action remain visible. Focus outlines the link without swapping image.
product.activate: Image/name link opens the correct product route. Color selection is a sibling button group, never nested in the link; click updates selected color, image and route.
product.touch: No hover dependency. Show stable primary image and explicit color names. Two columns at tablet, one at narrow phone.
product.react: ProductTout[] in ProductRange. ProductRange owns selectedVariantByProduct; product data owns image pairs, price and href. CSS handles hover; React handles selection.

project.scroll: Preserve asymmetric grid offsets. Each large photograph settles 12→0 px once; captions remain steady. No sticky panels or forced horizontal scrolling.
project.hover: Image scale 1→1.018 over 500 ms inside its crop; arrow moves 4 px over 180 ms. Title remains visible. Keyboard uses a 2 px focus outline.
project.activate: Whole image/caption is one descriptive link to the project page. Do not put a nested button inside it.
project.touch: One column in reading order, remove offsets; image and caption remain one 44 px+ target.
project.react: ProjectTout with project, size, offset and href props. CSS Grid places items; no hover state in React.

story.scroll: Large image enters naturally; supporting text reveals once with a 12 px/600 ms settle. No section pinning or content swapping caused by scrolling.
story.hover: Only the text action underlines; editorial photo stays still unless it is itself the linked tout.
story.activate: A descriptive story link opens its route. Noninteractive material photographs remain figure/figcaption.
story.touch: Image then copy in the same DOM order; remove desktop overlaps; keep 48–72 px between chapters.
story.react: EditorialTout with eyebrow, title, body, image, imageSide and optional href. Static content props; CSS grid does the composition.

disclosure.scroll: In normal flow. Opening increases document height without moving the trigger; reserve image space beside the questions.
disclosure.hover: Summary text darkens and the plus rotates 90° over 160 ms. No photo animation.
disclosure.activate: Enter/Space or click toggles native details/summary. Multiple answers may remain open. Expanded copy includes the relevant detail-page link.
disclosure.touch: Entire summary is a minimum 48 px row; no hover requirement. Reduced motion opens immediately.
disclosure.react: CareDisclosure using native details/summary. No duplicated React open state unless a future URL-deep-link requirement needs it.

selector.scroll: One stable product scene; section reveals as a unit. Changing selection never scrolls the page or changes section height.
selector.hover: Only selector outline/text responds over 160 ms. Do not rotate cans or move purchase controls.
selector.activate: Native radio group selects 4, 8 or 12 cans; selected pack, total price and product URL update together. Continue button navigates to the configured pack; no cart write in the reference gallery.
selector.touch: Use visible radio labels and 44 px targets; stack selector under product photo. Screen readers hear group legend and selected pack.
selector.react: PackSelector; parent owns selectedPackId. Compute price/units/href from one packs map rather than separate state variables.

steps.scroll: Natural reading order. Scroll never changes the selected step. One large active photograph gives the sequence space.
steps.hover: Step button underline brightens over 160 ms; no automatic selection on hover or focus.
steps.activate: Click/Enter chooses step and crossfades fixed-ratio media over 220 ms. aria-pressed buttons control a labelled region. No autoplay.
steps.touch: Three full-width or wrapping buttons remain visible; active description is below. Keyboard Tab/Enter works without a custom tab algorithm.
steps.react: RitualSteps or ServeSteps; selectedStepId in parent; image and description derived from steps data. CSS fade; respect reduced motion.

filter.scroll: Changing filter preserves the control’s position and uses normal document flow. No masonry reordering.
filter.hover: Underline category label over 160 ms; image behavior follows ProjectTout.
filter.activate: All/Culture/Living are ordinary filter links carrying ?type=. Selected state is aria-current; browser Back restores it. Show result count and empty state.
filter.touch: Labels wrap naturally. No horizontal drag required; 44 px targets.
filter.react: ProjectIndex receives type from router/searchParams; filters project data. CSS handles layout. No duplicated URL and component selection state.

journal.scroll: Two stories with different image proportions form one quiet composition. Reveal once per story, 80 ms maximum stagger.
journal.hover: Title underline and arrow translate 4 px. Optional image scale limited to 1.018; no hidden excerpt.
journal.activate: One link per story with a specific article title. Community captions only link when an actual owned story exists; decorative images have no pointer cursor.
journal.touch: Stack stories. Headline and short summary remain visible; no carousel required.
journal.react: StoryLink[] from journal content; each owns image, title, excerpt and href. State-free unless editorial pagination is added later.

signup.scroll: Static closing composition. Form never follows the user or opens an unsolicited modal.
signup.hover: Button changes fill/foreground over 160 ms; input retains a stable border. Focus ring is always explicit.
signup.activate: Real form submit uses idle/submitting/success/error. Validate email, prevent duplicate requests, announce status and preserve input on failure. Until endpoint exists label demo as not connected.
signup.touch: Visible label plus autocomplete=email; 44 px button. Success stays in place without redirect.
signup.react: NewsletterForm owns status and error; server action/API owns persistence. Keep inquiry CTA separate from marketing opt-in.

footer.scroll: Static footer in document flow with adequate bottom padding.
footer.hover: Simple underline only; logo remains still.
footer.activate: Real anchors to existing routes; future routes are documented as planned, not fake working links.
footer.touch: Groups stack and remain expanded; maintain clear reading order.
footer.react: SiteFooter from route groups and contact data. No animation state.

sites.name: Avela / Soft Form
sites.critique: Keep the campaign strength, remove repetitive triptychs. Products float on cream; the Arc story, craft and coastal story become large, unequal compositions. Workshop notes sit inside craft; community imagery sits inside the coastal story.
sites.spacing: Desktop chapters 144–192 px apart, side gutters clamp(24px,6vw,96px), 32–48 px internal gaps. Product grounds blend into the cream; no card outlines.
chapters: Approved SOFT FORM hero exactly as supplied.

After a generous cream pause, Forms for every day: three freestanding bags with subtle baseline labels; Arc $420, Fold $360, Day $480. No three background rectangles. Leave space around every silhouette.
Large pale-blue Arc flat lay on left occupying 55%; smaller serif copy floated on cream at right, separated by negative space. One short heading: Soft structure. Room for the everyday.

Shaped by hand: one substantial terracotta-toned handwork photograph on right and a smaller close-up offset below-left. Use a quiet cream field, not a solid stripe. A single workshop story link replaces a second journal grid.
Carried through the day: one large coastal campaign photo and a smaller on-body photograph offset like a magazine spread. Two tiny community captions share this composition, not another row.
Made to stay with you: calm wide cream pause, three fine accordion lines left, one small tactile leather detail right.
Blue newsletter breathing room; full oxblood footer with useful link columns.
